query: In what month is the annual documentary film festival, that is presented by the fortnightly published British journal of literary essays, held?

pipeline_result.response: The London International Documentary Festival (LIDF) is an annual documentary film festival that takes place in March and April every year. The event is presented in association with the London Review of Books (LRB).
retrieved_context: London International Documentary Festival: The London International Documentary Festival (or LIDF) is an annual documentary film festival that takes place in the months of March and April every year.  The event is presented in association with the London Review of Books.
London Review of Books: The London Review of Books (LRB) is a British journal of literary essays.  It is published fortnightly.
